proof_body:
by
  intro K _ f
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.maximal_ideal_iff_isField_quotient]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      have hb : (⊥ : Ideal (Polynomial K)).IsMaximal := by simpa using h
      exact Polynomial.not_isField K (Ring.isField_iff_maximal_bot.mpr hb)
    exact ((Ideal.span_singleton_prime hf).mp h.isPrime).irreducible
  · intro h
    exact PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible h
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (f : Polynomial K), IsField (Polynomial K ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) ↔ Irreducible f
